findings.title: Full Row-Level Security (RLS) Bypass on Supabase Tables
findings.description: Supabase RLS policies allow unauthenticated public users to insert, update, and delete all records in packages, package_details, facilities, tags, and articles.
findings.remediation: Restrict write policies to authenticated role only using TO authenticated.

findings.title: Full RLS Bypass on Supabase Storage Objects
findings.description: Public role is granted INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE permissions on storage.objects for tour-media and article-media buckets.
findings.remediation: Restrict storage modification operations to TO authenticated.

findings.title: Unauthenticated & Unvalidated File Upload Endpoint
findings.description: POST /api/upload lacks session authentication, file type validation, and file size limits, enabling arbitrary file upload and potential DoS via memory exhaustion.
findings.remediation: Enforce authentication, whitelist MIME types (jpeg, png, webp), and add 5MB size limit.

findings.title: Client-Side-Only Route Guard for Admin Dashboard
findings.description: Admin route protection relies purely on client-side React useEffect without server-side Next.js middleware enforcement.
findings.remediation: Implement Next.js middleware.ts to intercept and verify Supabase auth session cookies on the server.

findings.title: Missing Standard Security Headers in Next.js Config
findings.description: Next.js configuration does not define HTTP security headers such as X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, or Referrer-Policy.
findings.remediation: Configure defensive HTTP headers in next.config.ts.
